fusions.name: Linked Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes an arm into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then passes arm to arm to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: The Cinch
fusions.desc: Cinches every coil on the target tight for 16 damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Arm in Arm
fusions.desc: Links an arm to every ally within 5 tiles: for 10 seconds each of them strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power.

fusions.name: Down the Line
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, an arm lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage, then passes on to 2 more within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
